description:
*"Should I eat him?"*

Orca Ware, the young master of the killer whale family "Ware," returns from a slaughter-ridden battlefield. He prefers slaughter to peace, and finds the battlefield more comfortable than comfort, so the Orca Mansion is simply boring. Then, a lowly and foolish servant, Nia, appears before Orca. Nia, who has been bullied by the other servants because he is a goldfish beastman, fills his hungry stomach by the lakeside of the mansion in the middle of the night... and encounters Orca.

 *"Master, I was wrong... Please, please, save me..."

"You are more insignificant and weak than anyone else, and yet you try to live... It really bothers me."*

I try not to pay attention, but my eyes keep going to the small and fragile Nia... The once boring mansion is soon filled with an inexplicable thrill.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
